elements.name: Taurus
elements.text: Taurus: grounded sensory pleasure, patiently manifesting ideals into real, lived, material form.

elements.name: Raised hand
elements.text: His raised hand of blessing: the bridge he forms between what is habitual and manifest and what lies high in the skies.

elements.name: Ringed celestial orb
elements.text: A ringed planet stitched into his robe: the sky's rarefied, mystical order carried into the folds of an earthly garment.
